headline: Hajduk are favourites at Thun, but only just
summary: Hajduk Split come to Thun as Croatian league leaders and 2-1 winners over Ajax, with four wins in their last five. Their one away match in that run was a 0-3 defeat at Rijeka, and that is the reason the market keeps this close. Across the market average, with the margin removed, Hajduk are 39.9% and Thun 33.8%. The handicap rates Hajduk only 0.13 goals better, and the goal line is 3.0. Thun are 30th in the table with no points, but they are at home.
read: Hajduk Split come to Thun as Croatian league leaders and 2-1 winners over Ajax, and the market makes them favourites at 39.9%.

facts.fact: Hajduk Split are the favourites at 39.9% to Thun's 33.8%, with the draw at 26.2%.
facts.meaning: The away side is favoured, but only by six points of probability — this is close to a coin-flip between a Hajduk win and everything else.

facts.fact: The Asian handicap fair line is +0.13 — the market rates Hajduk only fractionally the better side, and Thun +0.25 is covered 54% of the time.
facts.meaning: A draw or a narrow Hajduk win is the market's central band: Thun avoiding defeat is slightly more likely than not.

facts.fact: Hajduk beat Ajax 2-1 in Split on 15 October in their Conference League opener.
facts.meaning: It is the standout result either side brings into this match, and the main reason Hajduk are the favourites.

facts.fact: The goal line is set at 3.0, with over priced at 48.4%.
facts.meaning: The market expects an open game of around three goals, a high line for a European tie between two sides who have barely met.

facts.fact: Thun managed just 0.2 xG in their 0-1 defeat at Twente on matchday one.
facts.meaning: Their first European outing produced almost no chances of their own, so the attacking end is the question mark going into this home game.

facts.fact: Hajduk's only away match in their last five was a 0-3 defeat at Rijeka on 20 September.
facts.meaning: Every win in their run has come in Split, so the away version of this team is far less proven than the form line suggests.

facts.fact: Thun's last five read DLLWL — one win and three defeats.
facts.meaning: The home side arrive on the weaker run of the two, which is why their home advantage has not made them favourites.

facts.fact: Thun are 30th of 36 in the Conference League table with no points; Hajduk are 10th with three.
facts.meaning: A first point of the league phase matters for a side already near the bottom — the home crowd has something concrete to play for.

sources.fact: Thun coach Privitelli pushes back on Croatian journalists' view that Hajduk are favourites.
Thun player Nicolas Bürgy says even a draw against the Ajax-beating Hajduk side would be valuable.
The match is treated as a high-risk game, with Bern cantonal police visibly present in Thun on Thursday after Hajduk fans chanted Nazi slogans before the Ajax match.
Thun are checking their own fans' loyalty before the visit of Hajduk, with fans puzzled by special controls.
Thun are described as struggling, in contrast to Lugano's unbeaten domestic run.
Hajduk Split are the Croatian league leaders coming to Thun, and are described as having consistently been among the top contenders domestically in recent years.
Hajduk beat Ajax in their Conference League MD1 match in Split on 15 October 2026.
Croatian police arrested at least a dozen Hajduk fans a day after supporters held an anti-Semitic rally, clashed with officers and interrupted the Ajax match.
